title: When Hate Meets Facts: LLMs-in-the-Loop for Check-worthiness Detection in Hate Speech

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing and disaggregating the distribution of check-worthiness classification labels (e.g., Check-worthy Factual Statement, Non-Factual Statement) across hate speech messages targeting disabled individuals using the MT-CONAN dataset.
Analyzing and disaggregating the distribution of check-worthiness classification labels across hate speech messages targeting specific religious groups (Jews, Muslims) using the MT-CONAN dataset.
Analyzing and disaggregating the distribution of check-worthiness classification labels across hate speech messages targeting the LGBT+ community using the MT-CONAN dataset.
Analyzing and disaggregating the distribution of check-worthiness classification labels across hate speech messages targeting migrants using the MT-CONAN dataset.
Analyzing and disaggregating the distribution of check-worthiness classification labels across hate speech messages targeting people of color (POC) using the MT-CONAN dataset.
Analyzing and disaggregating the distribution of check-worthiness classification labels across hate speech messages targeting women using the MT-CONAN dataset.
